about: What -importLayer (mappingLayers ML3-c; SPEC §2 'Import', §4.2, D-PROFILE) accepts, as DATA. layerKeyPattern: an imported layer is always imported-<slug>. builtInPrefixExpansion: the prefixes SSSOM itself defines (sssom-py's built-in map), which a declared prefix map need not repeat. predicateIriList: the ONLY predicates an imported row may carry, by full IRI: the SKOS mapping relations, the two OWL equivalences our declared bridges already carry, and EDUcore's own declared vocabulary terms (lib/edc-uri/uriScheme.json vocabularyTerm). noTermFoundIri: SSSOM's 'no term found' object (an abstention row). Anything else is refused by name, never mapped.
